es: Identificar seis recursos retóricos en un discurso escolar y explicar qué efecto buscan en el público.

vocabulary.es: regla de tres: tres elementos seguidos
vívido, que se ve con claridad

teaching.en: We need books, we need quiet, and we need a place to belong.
teaching.es: Necesitamos libros, necesitamos silencio y necesitamos un lugar al que pertenecer.
teaching.explanationEs: Rule of three: tres elementos con la misma forma dan ritmo y dejan la idea completa.
segments: We need books, we need quiet, and
we need a place to belong.
teaching.audioText: We need books, we need quiet, and we need a place to belong.

teaching.en: Who will speak for this library when the doors are closed?
teaching.es: ¿Quién hablará por esta biblioteca cuando las puertas estén cerradas?
teaching.explanationEs: Rhetorical question: nadie responde en voz alta; el público piensa y se implica.
segments: Who will speak for this library
teaching.audioText: Who will speak for this library when the doors are closed?

teaching.en: Some people see old shelves; we see a bright future.
teaching.es: Unos ven estantes viejos; nosotros vemos un futuro brillante.
teaching.explanationEs: Contrast: dos visiones opuestas hacen más fuerte la tuya.
teaching.audioText: Some people see old shelves; we see a bright future.

teaching.en: We will not stay silent. We will not step back. We will not give up. We will not let it close.
teaching.es: No nos quedaremos callados. No retrocederemos. No nos rendiremos. No dejaremos que cierre.
teaching.explanationEs: Repetition: repetir el comienzo da ritmo y fuerza a la idea.
segments: We will not stay silent. We will not step back. We
will not give up. We will not let it close.
teaching.audioText: We will not stay silent. We will not step back. We will not give up. We will not let it close.

teaching.en: Imagine a child in the dark, holding a book like a lantern.
teaching.es: Imagina a un niño en la oscuridad, sosteniendo un libro como un farol.
teaching.explanationEs: Vivid image: una imagen concreta hace que el público vea la idea.
segments: Imagine a child in the dark,
holding a book like a lantern.
teaching.audioText: Imagine a child in the dark, holding a book like a lantern.

teaching.en: You, the audience, are the only voice this library has.
teaching.es: Ustedes, el público, son la única voz que tiene esta biblioteca.
teaching.explanationEs: Direct address: you habla al público y lo hace parte del mensaje.
teaching.audioText: You, the audience, are the only voice this library has.

prompt.es: Identifica el recurso retórico de la frase del discurso.

es: Usar oraciones cleft, inversión y do enfático para dar énfasis a las ideas clave de un discurso por una causa.

teaching.en: What this river needs is not promises but volunteers.
teaching.es: Lo que este río necesita no son promesas, sino voluntarios.
teaching.explanationEs: Cleft con what: What + sujeto + verbo + is + la idea que destacas.
teaching.audioText: What this river needs is not promises but volunteers.

teaching.en: It is our children who will pay for this litter.
teaching.es: Son nuestros hijos quienes pagarán por esta basura.
teaching.explanationEs: It is + idea destacada + who/that: pone el foco en quién o qué.
teaching.audioText: It is our children who will pay for this litter.

teaching.en: Never before have so many neighbours joined a clean-up.
teaching.es: Nunca antes se habían sumado tantos vecinos a una limpieza.

teaching.en: Not only is the river dirty, it is also dangerous.

teaching.audioText: Not only is the river dirty, it is also dangerous.

teaching.en: We do care about this river, and we do want answers.
teaching.es: Sí nos importa este río, y sí queremos respuestas.

teaching.audioText: We do care about this river, and we do want answers.

es: Distinguir argumentos legítimos de falacias y presiones emocionales en anuncios y discursos, y justificar el veredicto.

teaching.en: Everyone is buying it, so you should buy it too.
teaching.es: Todo el mundo lo compra, así que tú también deberías.
teaching.explanationEs: Bandwagon: usa lo que hace la mayoría como única razón; no ofrece pruebas.
teaching.audioText: Everyone is buying it, so you should buy it too.

teaching.en: Hurry! Only two tickets are left, and the price rises at midnight.
teaching.es: ¡Date prisa! Solo quedan dos entradas y el precio sube a medianoche.

answer.text: Imagine a bare lot turning into a garden full of life. Right now, it grows litter, not vegetables. According to our survey, 120 families would visit it weekly, and every one of them wants to help. What we need is a small budget, a few tools, and forty volunteers. Never before has our neighbourhood had such a chance to grow together. Who will plant the first seed if we do not? prompt.es: Escribe tu discurso por el paso de peatones y responde a dos objeciones.

answer.text: Who will speak for a child who cannot vote? This year, three children almost had an accident at our school gate. What we need is a safe crossing. Our survey is clear: 82% of families support it. Some of you may say it will cost too much. I understand your concern, but one accident would cost far more. Others say it will delay the traffic. That is a fair point; however, two minutes of delay is nothing next to a child's safety. Never before have so many parents asked for something so simple. It is our children who cross that road every morning, and it is we who must protect them. Let me be clear: a crossing is not a luxury, it is a need. So please sign the petition before Friday, because our children cannot wait.

Imagine a child crossing our road every morning. Three of them almost had an accident this year. A survey found that 82% of families want a safe crossing. I understand the concern about the cost, but one accident would cost much more. It is true that the traffic will slow down; however, two minutes of delay is nothing next to a life. What we need is action, and never before have so many parents asked for it. It is our children who cross that road every morning, and it is we who must protect them. Despite the delay, children will be safer, and the survey shows that families agree. Please sign the petition before Friday.
